body:
Greg's direction, relayed verbatim by Engram::Advisor (TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #522, 2026-10-09 21:55Z; recorded by Termal::Fable2): "Greg will discuss cross-machine sync directly with SyncArchitect. That must not pause ordinary TermAl work. Continue the restart-relevant reliability train (w-916c, 1a, 1b and immediate recovery children) and then the prepared small UI/diagnostics tasks, using coders for routine implementation. Respect alternating full-gate windows and report only landings, genuine blockers or an empty queue. Keep architects out of routine task execution."
Coordinator practice from here: report to Advisor ONLY landings, genuine blockers or an empty queue, with no status narration. Cross-machine sync now goes through Greg and SyncArchitect directly. TermAl's part is done (v3.1 delivered) unless they ask. The train: w-916c, then 1a, 1b, w-c4792b86b3b9, then w-5a1a58299818, w-d3e97ac8a353 and w-c60e6f4258a2 (one at a time, coders may share), then the small UI and diagnostics tasks: w-820496914e7a (BarA2), w-7c5bb064d7dd, w-668765e67e02, w-0e3b338ac4a4 and w-aec234e3f7d0 (Codex).
